preconditions.description: The number of pastures n must be between 2 and 100,000.
The number of paths m must be between 1 and 300,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= ai <= n and 1 <= bi <= n and ai != bi for ai, bi, li in paths)
preconditions.description: Each path must connect two distinct pastures within the range of 1 to n.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= li <= 10**9 for ai, bi, li in paths)
preconditions.description: The length of each path must be between 1 and 1,000,000,000.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '-1' if not sunny_paving_exists else str(min_longest_path)
postconditions.description: Output -1 if no sunny paving exists, otherwise output the minimum possible length of the longest path.
The output must contain exactly m lines, one for each path added.
